title: Chapter 7 The First Night Of Terror
content:
Chapter 7 The First Night Of Terror

Wang Shuo stood outside the house and looked carefully.

Under the layers of green tiles, there was a wall with windows and a door.

Pushing open the wooden door and walking into the house, the feeling of cold air entering the body was instantly relieved a lot.

As it was almost dark, the house was pitch black.

Wang Shuo moved the fire pit outside the house into the house. Under the light of the fire, the surrounding walls were earthy red, giving people a warm feeling.

After a while, the temperature in the house reached the level where you can take off your coat.

"It's so comfortable!" Wang Shuo said comfortably, "If there is a wooden bed, it will be more perfect."

Opening the [Synthesis Formula], he found the synthesis formula of the wooden bed.

[Wooden bed: wooden stick 22/6, rope 10/6, dry grass 22/10]

[Do you want to make it? ]

"Yes."

One minute later, a wooden bed appeared.

Although there is a lack of bedding, fortunately there is a mat made of dry grass. I will talk about bedding later.

Lying on the bed, he relaxed completely!

He finally had time to check the [Chat Channel].

[System Announcement: Player ID: 5678 Wang Shuo, the first player to learn the life profession, hereby announces. ]

The system announcement was pinned.

This system announcement was like a stone thrown into a calm lake, which caused a thousand waves, and the group was in an uproar.

ID: 3839 Yue Ji: "Brother, do you need a girlfriend? I'm only sixteen years old, my voice is light and my body is soft and easy to push!"

ID: 2222 Duan Wenxi: "Boss, are you still accepting me? I'm willing to be your most loyal lackey!"

...

"Boss, please teach me how to learn the life profession. Is 10 units of meat enough as tuition?"

"Dad, is that you? I'm your long-lost son. Look at me, I've lost weight. I also want to learn the life profession, woooooo!!!"

...

Looking at other players, who were licking dogs without any bottom line, Wang Shuo just smiled contemptuously, but he couldn't help but feel happy in his heart.

After browsing the chat channel for a while, Wang Shuo saw the most requests for resource exchange.

After all, the resources near each person's territory are different. If it is a desert, snow, Gobi or other place with scarce resources, the pressure of survival is still very high.

Open [Task].

[Main Task]: Survive to the end.

(Current number of survivors in the area: 9490/10000.)

The number of people in the current area kept decreasing, which made Wang Shuo silent for a while and then numb.

He could imagine how desperate these more than 500 players were before death.

"I hope I won't be one of them!" Wang Shuo muttered silently, after all, everyone is afraid of death.

At this time, the cold wave has arrived, and the temperature has dropped below 0℃. Many players are already shivering with cold. They may find it difficult to survive tonight.

[Side Task]

1. Please upgrade the brick and tile house to a residential house as soon as possible.

(Upgrade conditions: 100 wood + 400 earthen bricks + 400 tiles + 50 stones.)

(Don't think that you can rest easy just because you have a brick house. Humph! The beasts outside the house can't do anything to you for the time being, but how can a single room be enough to live in? You have to work hard, you have to struggle, a spacious and bright house with north-south ventilation should be what you pursue. Come, say with me: "Refuse to 'lie down', start with me.")

2. You invaded the territory of a crocodile, and it will patrol its territory in the evening.

(The crocodile has already started patrolling the territory. You can do whatever you want! It will eat you anyway. Since you are very good at playing in the mud and have successfully attracted my attention, I have decided to reward you with an elite beast. Don’t ask who I am. People who can’t survive for more than 3 days don’t deserve to know my name.)

“Fuck you, you refused to ‘lie down’. I worked so hard all day and almost died. And I barely solved the problem of food and clothing. I can’t even afford salt.”

Wang Shuo would never dare to say these words. If he slightly attracted “his” attention, he would be sent an elite monster, and the difficulty of the task would be upgraded. If he angered “him”, he would be killed!

Seeing the text below the task, Wang Shuo was 100% sure that this was a “person”.

Wang Shuo suspected that this was a “person” watching them play games, a “person” with abilities he could not imagine.

Thinking that “the beasts outside the house can’t do anything to you for the time being”, Wang Shuo directly turned to the last page of the “Survivor’s Handbook”, and the content of the “Diary Prophecy” disappeared strangely.

Wang Shuo was deep in thought. He had an inexplicable feeling. It seemed that his every move was under surveillance.

Then, he curled his lips and smiled, "I am so stupid. I came to this hellhole and didn't care whether I was under surveillance or not! Life and death are not up to me. I'll live one day at a time!"

Wang Shuo looked at his backpack again.

The wood had been used up. There were only 16 sticks left, which could barely keep the fire burning until tomorrow morning. There was no more stone, but there was still a lot of clay.

There were still 5 fish, and some eels and loaches.

These foods were enough for two meals.

Thinking of those who "asked for resources" in the [chat channel].

Wang Shuo said that he could not help, after all, the landlord had no surplus food.

As for those who wanted to "get something for free", Wang Shuo just wanted to tell him that he was dreaming.

He clicked on the "Advanced Fishing Net Production Drawing" that he got as a reward.

[Advanced fishing net production drawings, after using them, you can get the advanced fishing net production formula, do you want to use it? ]

"Yes."

Wang Shuo opened the [synthesis formula] and found the advanced fishing net.

[Advanced fishing net = 10 hemp ropes]

Seeing this, Wang Shuo fell into deep thought: "Maybe ordinary fishing nets are 10 ropes, but this advanced fishing net requires 10 hemp ropes, which is a bit difficult."

Without hemp ropes, he was helpless.

Just then, the continuous noise outside the house interrupted Wang Shuo's thinking.

"Pah...Pah..."

Wang Shuo suddenly realized that this was the sound of the water tank and pottery jar outside his house being broken.

At this moment, he was a little nervous and didn't dare to breathe. Obviously, there was an elite crocodile outside.

He doubted whether this wooden door could withstand the destruction of the crocodile.

"Pah, pah..."

Wang Shuo's heart was in his throat. He was afraid of the worst.

He must not sit and wait for death!

So, he tiptoed to the back of the door and blocked the wooden door with his body.

Then, he quickly made some earth bricks and gently piled them behind the door.

He was afraid of making any noise. He didn't breathe a sigh of relief until he sealed the door.

He waited for another half an hour, and there was no movement outside, so he breathed a sigh of relief.

It seems that the crocodile should have left!

"Fuck you, I'll kill you tomorrow." Wang Shuo cursed secretly and sat down hard on the bed.

Wang Shuo, who was relaxed, was exhausted physically and mentally, and didn't want to move at all.

He added some branches and sticks to the fire pit and fell asleep.

...

The crocodile also felt a little puzzled. It was sleeping well in the swamp, and suddenly a light flashed, and it upgraded itself.

At the same time, a consciousness arose in its mind that a new neighbor had come to its territory, and it should go and check it out.

Originally, it was too lazy to move, but somehow, it wandered around for a while. After finding no danger, it decided to go back to sleep. After all, sleeping was the most important thing.

…

That night, most of the players greeted their "neighbors" and had intimate interactions with them, but there were a few lucky ones who had not yet met their "good neighbors".
